episodes.title: Die Klatts
episodes.summary: When their missing daughter's shirt turns up in a neighborhood donation bin, Carlotta and Dedo come up with a wild idea to find her.

episodes.title: Die Hessels
episodes.summary: Dedo clumsily breaks into the home of a teacher from Wanda's school. Ole discovers what his parents are doing and makes a suggestion.

episodes.title: Die Roths
episodes.summary: After a session at her therapist's house, Carlotta spots something suspicious. Detective Rauch gets a troubling update on the case.

episodes.title: Die Vinsons
episodes.summary: Carlotta forms a bond with Lucie Vinson, Wanda's schoolmate. Dedo and Ole stumble upon a new clue.

episodes.title: Die Novaks
episodes.summary: Dedo's secret is exposed. Ole attends Games World and meets Chris, who gives him hopeful news about Wanda.

episodes.title: Die Küchlers
episodes.summary: Carlotta and Dedo find themselves in a scary situation, and it forces them to confront their problems.

episodes.title: Ilse Rubner
episodes.summary: The Klatts forge a plan to cover their tracks after Detective Rauch suspects the homes in their neighborhood are bugged.

episodes.title: Wandafest
episodes.summary: Season finale. With the festival underway, the Klatts set out on their mission—and make a shocking discovery.
